name: arrays
source: a=(zero 'one two'); declare -A m=([key]=value); printf 'RESULT:%s:%s\n' "${a[1]}" "${m[key]}"

name: nameref-arithmetic
source: n=3; declare -n ref=n; ((ref+=4)); printf 'RESULT:%s:%s\n' "$n" "${unset_value:-fallback}"

name: pipeline-status
source: set -o pipefail; true | false; printf 'RESULT:%s:%s\n' "$?" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"

name: command-substitution
source: text=$(printf 'a b'); [[ $text == a* ]]; printf 'RESULT:%s:%s\n' "$?" "$text"

name: here-string-read
source: read -r first rest <<< 'one two three'; printf 'RESULT:%s:%s\n' "$first" "$rest"

name: loop-case
source: for x in one two; do case $x in one) printf 'RESULT:first\n';; *) printf 'RESULT:second\n';; esac; done

name: quoted-heredoc
source:
cat <<'END'
RESULT:literal $text
END

name: script-argv
source:
#!/usr/bin/env fish
a=(one "two three"); printf "%s:%s:%s\n" "${a[1]}" "$0" "$#"; printf "<%s>\n" "$@"

name: script-stdio-status
source: IFS= read -r line; printf "stdin:%s\n" "$line"; printf "stderr\n" >&2; exit 37

name: script-exec
source: exec /bin/sh -c 'printf "exec:%s\n" "$1"; exit 23' child "$1"

name: script-exit-trap
source: trap 'printf "exiting:%s\n" "$?"' EXIT; false

name: source-state
origin: Original integration fixture; state observed through shell commands

files.state.bash:
declare -a items=(zero "one two")
export SHARED_STATE="from source"
function retained() { printf "FUNCTION:%s\n" "$SHARED_STATE"; }
alias retained_alias=retained
cd directory
return 7

source:
shopt -s expand_aliases
source ./state.bash
printf "SOURCE-STATUS:%s\n" "$?"
printf "PWD:%s\n" "$PWD"
printf "ARRAY:%s\n" "${items[1]}"
declare -f retained
retained_alias
/bin/sh -c 'printf "EXPORTED:%s\n" "$SHARED_STATE"'

name: file-redirection-order
origin: Original integration fixture; external files are compared exactly
source:
mkdir directory
printf "first\n" > "directory/file ü ;$"
printf "second\n" >> "directory/file ü ;$"
ln -s "file ü ;$" directory/link
{ printf "stdout\n"; printf "stderr\n" >&2; } > combined 2>&1
{ printf "stdout\n"; printf "stderr\n" >&2; } 2>&1 > separate
chmod 640 combined

name: dynamic-function-scope
origin: Original integration fixture; function/local state observed via execution

name: assignment-and-condition-order
source:
a=outer
f() { printf '%s:%s:%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$1"; }
a=inner b=$a f "$a"
echo "$a:${b-unset}"
false; printf '%s:%s\n' "$(true)" "$?"
x=$(false); printf 'status:%s\n' "$?"
[[ yes || $(touch wrong) ]] && [[ '' && $(touch wrong) || yes ]]
echo "$?"

name: redirect-scope-and-input-offset
source:
{ printf 'one\n'; printf 'two\n'; /bin/echo three; } > output
cat output
while IFS= read -r line; do printf '<%s>\n' "$line"; done < output
f() { printf 'f-one\n'; printf 'f-two\n'; }
f > function-output
cat function-output

name: pipeline-expansion-isolation
source:
x=0
printf '%s\n' "$((x+=1))" | cat
printf 'parent:%s\n' "$x"

name: arithmetic-array-indices
source:
a=(zero one two); i=1
printf '%s\n' "${a[i+1]}"
a[i+2]=three
printf '<%s>\n' "${a[@]}"

name: errexit-andor
source:
set -e
false && echo wrong
echo retained
true && false
echo wrong

name: unquoted-heredoc
source:
v=expanded
cat <<END
$v "$v" \$v $(printf sub) $((1+2))
END
